# Batch multi-column responsiveLockPolicy transitions into one rebuild

## Context

Surfaced during multi-column responsive grid verification (`#21187` / `#21524`, `MESSAGE:794a1eff-246a-484d-b6a3-33e5124306a3`): when a `Neo.grid.Container#responsiveLockPolicy` breakpoint changes the `locked` region of two or more columns in a single width evaluation (for example unlocking two `start` columns and one `end` column at `maxWidth: 500`, or re-locking them on desktop), `applyResponsiveLockPolicy` triggers `N` concurrent `async onColumnLockChange` rebuilds in the same synchronous tick instead of a single atomic transition.

## The Problem

In `src/grid/Container.mjs:1177-1185`, `applyResponsiveLockPolicy(data)` iterates synchronously over `breakpoint.columns` and assigns `column.locked = locked` for each column whose target region differs:

1. Assignment `1` (`col3.locked = null`) fires `column.Base#afterSetLocked` → `async grid.onColumnLockChange(col3)` (`src/grid/Container.mjs:1301`), which runs `me.columns.clearSilent(); me.columns.add(sortedColumns)` (`onColumnsMutate` rebuild `#1` while remaining columns in the breakpoint still hold their stale `locked` values) and suspends at `await Promise.all(me.headerWrapper.getToolbars().map(toolbar => toolbar.passSizeToBody()))` (or earlier at `await cellEditing.holdEdit()` when a cell edit is active).
2. In the **same synchronous tick**, assignment `2` (`col4.locked = null`) and assignment `3` (`col2.locked = null`) enter concurrent `onColumnLockChange` executions, firing `me.columns.clearSilent(); me.columns.add(sortedColumns)` (`onColumnsMutate` `#2`, `#3`) in the same tick and interleaving `passSizeToBody()`, `body.createViewData()`, and `cellEditing.holdEdit()` / `releaseEdit()`.
3. As documented directly in `src/grid/Container.mjs:1338-1341`, running the sub-grid layout rebuild more than once in the same tick causes racing `view.items` VDOM assignments against a stale vnode (risking duplicate region-body DOM nodes, ghost column positions across `await passSizeToBody()`, and premature `holdEdit()` bypass when `session.held++` returns `Promise.resolve()` on the second overlapping call before the first `repaintRow` settles).

## The Architectural Reality

- `Design authority: "Reuse the existing runtime setter path (column.locked = ...) so partitioning, header synchronization, scroll manager sync, and body refresh stay centralized. ... An additional explicit onColumnsMutate() call here would run the rebuild twice in the same tick: two racing view.items assignments diff against a stale vnode and insert duplicate region-body DOM nodes"` (`#12934` Contract Ledger + `src/grid/Container.mjs:1338-1341`; group-atomicity invariant in `src/grid/Container.mjs:1297-1298` from `#20379` / `#20511`).
- `Neo.grid.Container#syncingGroupLock` (`src/grid/Container.mjs:1291, 1305-1307, 1315-1325`) already provides the exact re-entrancy guard used when `onColumnLockChange` propagates a `headerGroup`'s `locked` state across sibling leaf columns so `afterSetLocked` updates every column's reactive config without triggering `N` intermediate `onColumnLockChange` rebuilds.
- `GridContainer#onResize` (`src/grid/Container.mjs:1596-1598`) calls `me.applyResponsiveLockPolicy(data)` synchronously before `await me.passSizeToBody(true)` and expects `applyResponsiveLockPolicy` to return a synchronous `Boolean` (`LockedColumns.spec.mjs:476-482`) with all matched columns already reflecting their new `locked` values.

## The Fix

In `src/grid/Container.mjs` (`applyResponsiveLockPolicy`):

1. Batch all `breakpoint.columns` mutations for which `column && locked !== undefined && column.locked !== locked` inside `me.syncingGroupLock = true` (`try { ... } finally { me.syncingGroupLock = false }`), recording the last mutated `column`.
2. Within the guarded pass, when a mutated `column` belongs to a `headerGroup`, propagate `sibling.locked = locked` to every column in `me.columns.items` sharing `column.headerGroup.id` so multi-group responsive transitions preserve `#20379` / `#20511`'s single-region group invariant before sorting.
3. After resetting `me.syncingGroupLock = false`, if at least one column changed, invoke `me.onColumnLockChange(lastColumn)` **once** and return `true` synchronously (otherwise return `false`). Update JSDoc `@summary` tags on `applyResponsiveLockPolicy` and `syncingGroupLock`.
4. Add unit coverage in `test/playwright/unit/grid/LockedColumns.spec.mjs` verifying that:
   - a multi-column breakpoint transition (`>= 3` columns across `start` and `end`) fires `columns` `mutate` / `onColumnLockChange` / `passSizeToBody` / `holdEdit` **once** rather than `N` times while settling in the exact sorted region order;
   - a multi-column breakpoint naming a grouped leaf moves its entire `headerGroup` alongside another column in a single rebuild;
   - a no-op breakpoint (all named columns already in target state) triggers zero `onColumnLockChange` calls and returns `false`.

## Contract Ledger

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback / Edge Case | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Neo.grid.Container#applyResponsiveLockPolicy(data)` | `#12934` Contract Ledger + `src/grid/Container.mjs:1156-1188, 1291-1360` | Synchronously updates `column.locked` (and any matching `headerGroup` siblings) for all changed entries in the matched breakpoint under `syncingGroupLock`, then invokes `onColumnLockChange` once and returns `true`. | Returns `false` and invokes `onColumnLockChange` zero times when width/policy is absent or all matched columns already hold their target `locked` state; omitted columns remain user-owned. | `@summary` JSDoc on `applyResponsiveLockPolicy` and `syncingGroupLock` in `src/grid/Container.mjs`. | Unit: `test/playwright/unit/grid/LockedColumns.spec.mjs` (multi-column batch count, grouped-column batch, no-op return). |

## Decision Record impact

none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1 (Single rebuild per multi-column breakpoint):** When `applyResponsiveLockPolicy` transitions `>= 2` columns in one breakpoint evaluation, all target columns update `locked` synchronously before `applyResponsiveLockPolicy` returns `true`, and `onColumnLockChange` / `columns` `mutate` / `cellEditing.holdEdit` execute **once** for the entire breakpoint transition rather than once per changed column.
- [ ] **AC-2 (Header-group atomicity in multi-column breakpoints):** When a multi-column breakpoint changes `locked` on a column with a `headerGroup` alongside another column, all siblings sharing `headerGroup.id` move to the target region within the same single `onColumnLockChange` rebuild without splitting the group across regions.
- [ ] **AC-3 (No-op & omitted-column preservation):** When all columns named in the matched breakpoint already hold their normalized target `locked` state, `applyResponsiveLockPolicy` returns `false` and fires zero `onColumnLockChange` rebuilds; omitted columns retain user-owned `locked` states.

## Out of Scope

- Changing `applyResponsiveLockPolicy`'s synchronous `Boolean` return signature into an `async` method (`onResize` relies on synchronous `locked` state updates prior to `passSizeToBody(true)`).
- Deduplicating direct caller loops outside `applyResponsiveLockPolicy` or changing `CellEditing#holdEdit`'s overlapping-caller promise contract (captured separately via `defect-note`).

## Avoided Traps

- **Bypassing `column.locked` setters via `_locked` silent writes:** Writing `_locked` directly skips reactive config subscribers on `Neo.grid.column.Base`; guarding the standard `column.locked = locked` setter with `me.syncingGroupLock` preserves reactive config notifications while coalescing the grid-level `onColumnLockChange` layout rebuild to one call.
- **Propagating `headerGroup` only for `lastColumn` inside `onColumnLockChange`:** If two different `headerGroup` columns (or a grouped column followed by an ungrouped column) change in one breakpoint, relying on `onColumnLockChange(lastColumn)`'s single-column `headerGroup` pass would miss earlier grouped columns in the batch; propagating `headerGroup` siblings inside the batch loop keeps every group intact.
